correctness_fixes_2026_10_27.summary: Every prior GPU decode bench of Llama-3.1-8B Q4_K_M on this card produced all-NaN logits at full speed; bench-real-model never inspected outputs (decode feeds a constant token). Found via the new NaN-tolerant logits fingerprint + TEMPURA_DEBUG_NAN per-op trace.
correctness_fixes_2026_10_27.bug_1_fused_silu_format: has_sm120_fused_silu() lacked the !uses_raw_gguf gate its sm_80 sibling documents; the sm120 fused gate+up+SiLU kernel parses repacked 42-u32 but was fed native 36-u32 weights -> every block misparsed + reads past tensor end. First NaN: L0 gate-silu, 12262/14336. Fixed by gating; porting the kernel to native format is follow-up work.
correctness_fixes_2026_10_27.bug_2_cpasync_visibility: q6k_gemv_sm120_mbar_kpar8/batch: cp.async.wait_group is a PER-THREAD wait; no barrier after it, so lanes read smem words copied by other lanes before landing (word 0 is raw f32 bits -> NaN). 1-6/14336 NaN varying per run. Fixed with CTA bar.sync 0 after each wait (canonical pattern); host selects the mbar kernel only when k_blocks % 8 == 0 (uniform barrier counts -> no deadlock).
correctness_fixes_2026_10_27.verification: TEMPURA_DEBUG_NAN trace: 0 NaN lines. 3x runs: identical logits fingerprint bits_sum=283107618863711 argmax=83334 nan=0.
